fields.Name: IT11 - Remote Operations (4th Data Primitive)
fields.Description: Full-stack (in-process) proof of the Remote Operations architecture (BaseRemotableOperation). Each op is invoked exactly as any caller would — new Op().Execute(input, { provider, user }) — routing through the real provider dispatch (ClassFactory → RouteOperation → ExecuteServer → Authorize → InternalExecute → engine → SQL). Deterministic, no model calls. RO1: Template.Run renders by ID with data (exact output). RO2: a non-existent template fails cleanly (Success=false, no throw). RO3: RecordProcess.RunNow { dryRun: true } previews and writes nothing. RO5: RunNow (LongRunning) emits typed RemoteOpProgress to an attached onProgress callback. RO4: { dryRun: false } applies the rule set (DB rows updated). RO6: GetRunStatus returns status + counts by ProcessRunID. RO7: Pause/Resume/Cancel control ops toggle CancellationRequested. Creates + deletes its own Template/Content/Category/Record Process fixtures.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Template.Run renders (and fails cleanly on missing); RecordProcess.RunNow dry-run/apply/progress/status/control ops all route through the real op stack and behave as specified.
